source_snapshot.items: Boot Order - Set boot option to Virtual ISO
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify BIOS host interface/network settings, mount and import ISO in BMC Web, set EFI cdrom override, read bootparam, reboot to Virtual ISO, observe flag clear.
source_snapshot.criteria: Node boots into Virtual ISO and option matches setting.
source_snapshot.script: None; 10 attended and 30 machine minutes; source requests log clearing.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic Once/Cd PATCH with TLS bypass, inline credentials and no ISO mount/identity evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at CRITICAL risk; signed ISO, protected mount/readback, non-destructive boot marker, auto-clear, detach and order restoration.

historical_reviews.deepseek: A guessed Cd override neither mounts nor identifies VirtualMedia and could boot the wrong device; it omits image integrity, install boundary, detach, clear timing and recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly governs image provenance, import/mount state, one-time boot and no-disk-write observation before explicit cleanup.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Virtual ISO acceptance requires two identities to agree: the mounted BMC VirtualMedia image and the pre-OS media actually executed. A generic optical boot flag proves neither. A non-destructive marker must terminate the test before any installer writes local storage.

original_test_intent: Mount the approved Virtual ISO, apply a one-time EFI optical override, prove the node enters that exact image without installing, then consume the flag, detach media and restore normal boot.
original_method: Verify target and BIOS prerequisites, validate ISO checksum/signature and safe marker, import/mount through the supported protected BMC path and read it back, set/read a one-time Virtual ISO override, reboot with operator approval, confirm the expected marker on console, stop before disk write, then verify auto-clear, eject and unchanged BootOrder.
manual_activity: The owner approves the exact image and no-install boundary; an operator confirms console marker, stops any installer, detaches media and owns recovery and verdict.
required_inputs: Approved ISO source, checksum/signature, architecture and safe marker
BIOS Host Interface and Network Stack semantics
Normal BootOrder/bootparam baseline and clear timing
Maintenance window, backup and reboot approval
safety_requirements: Never proceed into installer or disk-write flow
Use Once scope and do not alter persistent order
Read back mounted image and flag before reboot
Stop on wrong image, persistent media/flag or timeout
agent_execution_scope: Mount/read back approved media after authorization
Collect POST/console marker and clear timing
engineer_actions: Approve image and safe stopping point
Observe pre-OS console and prevent writes

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic Cd Once override is only one step; it guesses mapping, handles secrets unsafely and lacks VirtualMedia mount identity, no-install proof, flag clear, eject and recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-supported protected VirtualMedia mount/readback and one-time optical selector for the exact image, observe only the approved boot marker, then detach and prove order restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/30-minute estimates, BIOS prechecks, BMC-Web import, reboot and clear note remain; installation is explicitly outside scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate ISO checksum, VirtualMedia resource/readback, override state and console marker in one timeline, with a hard stop before installer actions and verified detach/clear/order restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable image identity, safe marker, write boundary and deterministic cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Cd PATCH cannot prove which ISO was mounted or executed and cannot establish that local disks were untouched.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some BMCs retain inserted media independently of the one-time flag; both media state and boot override must be cleared and checked.

project_override_considerations: The Project must identify the safe boot marker and separately authorize any OS installation. BIOS setting changes, if required, need their own change/restore plan.
expected_evidence: Approved target, BIOS prerequisite and normal boot baseline
POST/console proof of exact image safe marker with no disk write
Flag consumption, ISO eject and unchanged BootOrder
OS/BMC health, preserved logs, recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target Virtual ISO boot. The BIOS prerequisites and import steps are supporting conditions rather than competing scopes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Approved image, schema, marker, console, reboot window and recovery are normal prerequisites; execution blocks only if these cannot be established safely.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic optical override from substituting for verified VirtualMedia mounting and establishes a hard no-install boundary with complete cleanup.
independent_technical_reasoning: Optical boot selection identifies a device class, not the mounted content. Cached or previously inserted media could satisfy the flag while running the wrong image. Binding immutable ISO identity to BMC readback and a unique console marker closes that gap, and explicit eject plus flag/order checks prevents a later reboot from unexpectedly returning to installer media.
